posts.text:
LISTEN: “Heart of Texas” released today by @BriscoeBand remembering the Texas Hill Country floods & the lives lost.  It’s beautiful.

I would do anything to go back a year to stop the torrential rains or to fix a broken system or change a decision.  So many of us would.

But that is not how it works.

Instead, we believe.  In God.  In the cross.  In each other.

My family, my staff, and I will be with our people tomorrow in Kerrville to celebrate - both the greatness of America and the faith in
posts.summary: Expresses sympathy for flood victims, accepts limits of political action
